title: A structural model of a Ras-Raf signalosome.
authors: Mysore, Venkatesh P; Zhou, Zhi-Wei; Ambrogio, Chiara; Li, Lianbo; Kapp, Jonas N; Lu, Chunya; Wang, Qi; Tucker, Maxwell R; Okoro, Jeffrey J; Nagy-Davidescu, Gabriela; Bai, Xiaochen; Pluckthun, Andreas; Janne, Pasi A; Westover, Kenneth D; Shan, Yibing; Shaw, David E
one_liner_zh: 该文构建Ras-Raf信号复合物的原子结构模型，核心是蛋白-蛋白互作，不涉及蛋白质-DNA结合或转录因子体系，且方法为MD模拟但对象与互作轴均不匹配。
abstract: The protein K-Ras functions as a molecular switch in signaling pathways regulating cell growth. In the human mitogen-activated protein kinase (MAPK) pathway, which is implicated in many cancers, multiple K-Ras proteins are thought to assemble at the cell membrane with Ras effector proteins from the Raf family. Here we propose an atomistic structural model for such an assembly. Our starting point was an asymmetric guanosine triphosphate-mediated K-Ras dimer model, which we generated using unbiased molecular dynamics simulations and verified with mutagenesis experiments. Adding further K-Ras monomers in a head-to-tail fashion led to a compact helical assembly, a model we validated using electron microscopy and cell-based experiments. This assembly stabilizes K-Ras in its active state and presents composite interfaces to facilitate Raf binding. Guided by existing experimental data, we then positioned C-Raf, the downstream kinase MEK1 and accessory proteins (Galectin-3 and 14-3-3sigma) on and around the helical assembly. The resulting Ras-Raf signalosome model offers an explanation for a large body of data on MAPK signaling.
abstract_zh: 蛋白K-Ras在调控细胞生长的信号通路中充当分子开关。在人类丝裂原活化蛋白激酶（MAPK）通路中，该通路与多种癌症相关，多个K-Ras蛋白被认为在细胞膜上与Raf家族的Ras效应蛋白组装。在此，我们提出了这种组装的一个原子级结构模型。我们的起点是一个不对称的三磷酸鸟苷介导的K-Ras二聚体模型，该模型通过无偏分子动力学模拟生成，并通过诱变实验验证。以头尾相接的方式添加更多K-Ras单体，形成了一个紧凑的螺旋组装体，我们通过电子显微镜和基于细胞的实验验证了这一模型。该组装体将K-Ras稳定在其活性状态，并提供复合界面以促进Raf结合。在现有实验数据的指导下，我们将C-Raf、下游激酶MEK1及辅助蛋白（Galectin-3和14-3-3sigma）定位在螺旋组装体上及其周围。由此产生的Ras-Raf信号体模型为大量关于MAPK信号传导的数据提供了解释。
